ex.en: I attended a writing workshop last weekend.
ex.zh: 我上週末參加了一個寫作工作坊。

ex.en: The workshop will teach you basic coding skills.
ex.zh: 這個工作坊會教你基本的程式技能。

ex.en: I adapted the garage for use as a workshop.
An old worker was found repairing machinery in the workshop.
ex.zh: 有人看到一位老工人在車間裡修理機器。

ex.en: My workload has doubled since my colleague left.
ex.zh: 同事離職後，我的工作量多了一倍。

ex.en: We need to share the workload more fairly.
ex.zh: 我們需要更公平地分擔工作量。
